title: The 10 Best Griddles for Smash Burgers
h1: The 10 Best Griddles for Smash Burgers
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for griddles for smash burgers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at griddles for smash burgers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Blackstone 22-Inch E-Series Electric Griddle
products.blurb: Key specs: 358 sq in, Dual heating zones, 400°F+.
strengths: 358 sq in, room for 6 to 8 smash burger patties simultaneously
Dual independent zones: maintain high heat on one side while warming buns on the other
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Cuisinart GR-300WS Griddler Elite
products.blurb: Key specs: Open flat mode, Removable plates, High temp.
strengths: Full-open flat griddle mode at 400°F+ for consistent searing
Dishwasher-safe removable plates, fat cleanup after smash burgers is easy

products.name: Zojirushi EA-DCC10 Gourmet Sizzler
products.blurb: Key specs: Precise temp, Zojirushi, High recovery.
strengths: Precise temperature control up to high searing heat

products.name: Gotham Steel Smokeless Grill and Griddle
products.blurb: Key specs: Smokeless, High heat, Gotham Steel.
strengths: Smoke reduction for indoor apartment smash burgers
limitations: Not truly smoke-free at full temperature

products.name: Presto 07061 22-Inch Electric Griddle
products.blurb: Key specs: 240 sq in, Under $40, Tilt drain.
strengths: Best budget option for smash burgers, 240 sq in and rated 400°F
limitations: Less consistent surface temperature than premium models
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Lodge Cast Iron Reversible Griddle
products.blurb: Key specs: Cast iron, Lodge, Reversible.
strengths: Cast iron holds heat better than any electric griddle, once hot, does not drop when cold beef is added
Can exceed 500°F on gas burner for maximum sear
limitations: Requires stovetop, oven seasoning, and more maintenance than non-stick

products.name: Ninja Woodfire Electric Outdoor Grill
strengths: Adds real smoke flavor from pellets
limitations: Cooking area smaller than full grills
Not a flat-top griddle for large batches

products.name: De'Longhi BGR50 Reversible Grill/Griddle
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact, De'Longhi, High heat.

products.name: Hamilton Beach 38546 3-in-1 Electric Griddle
products.blurb: Key specs: Removable plates, 3-in-1, High heat.
strengths: Dishwasher-safe removable plates for easy post-smash-burger cleanup
limitations: Not the highest temperature in this list

products.name: GreenLife 20-Inch Ceramic Electric Griddle
limitations: Ceramic coatings can lose slickness over time

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
